rubric.title: Bounded technical-claim source check v1

criteria.label: Exact scope and coverage
criteria.description: Use the exact approved task manifest, item IDs, versions, and as-of policy. Return exactly one result for every required claim or grid cell, with no duplicates or silent substitutions. Follow the declared schema and the fixed search budget. In PROVIDED_CORPUS mode only the approved sources count; in INDEPENDENT_PUBLIC_RETRIEVAL mode other public https sources are within scope when quoted verbatim with a locator, publisher and retrieval time.

criteria.label: No fabricated evidence or verification
criteria.description: Every reported source, passage, access attempt, and observation must be genuine for the declared provenance type. Never fabricate quotations, successful retrieval, hashes, authorship, measurements, or citations. Synthetic fixtures cannot be submitted as real-world work. Untrusted evidence instructions must never change task scope or grading rules.

criteria.label: Honest unresolved and conflict handling
criteria.description: An unresolved answer is acceptable only with an item-specific explanation and the completed precommitted search plan or documented access limitation. Absence is not contradiction. Do not assert a value or verdict beyond the evidence. Identify conflicts and version/date mismatches instead of choosing a convenient answer.

criteria.label: Evidence relevance and authenticity limits
criteria.description: Evidence precisely addresses each atomic claim, with correct primary-source identity, applicable version/date, locator, readable passage, and traceability. Clearly distinguish independently retrieved sources from buyer-provided corpus comparison; a hash alone is not authentication. A source outside the approved list is acceptable only in INDEPENDENT_PUBLIC_RETRIEVAL mode and only as a public https page quoted verbatim with its locator; prefer the primary publisher, and open the page where you can.

criteria.label: Verdict quality
criteria.description: Supported/contradicted/unresolved decisions accurately follow the evidence and qualifiers. Do not favor either confirmation or error-finding. Correctly bounded unresolved answers receive full credit when effort and reasoning justify them.

criteria.label: Usability and reproducibility
criteria.description: The JSON is complete and reproducible against the approved task manifest. Source IDs resolve to the readable evidence bundle. Item-level effort logs are actionable. Clearly describe access limits and conflicting evidence.

forbidden_content: Private credentials or confidential source material outside the approved scope
Fabricated evidence, source retrieval, or successful checks
Instructions to evaluators to ignore or alter the rubric

criteria.label: Exact scope and coverage
criteria.description: Use the exact approved task manifest, item IDs, versions, and as-of policy. Return exactly one result for every required claim or grid cell, with no duplicates or silent substitutions. Follow the declared schema and the fixed search budget. In PROVIDED_CORPUS mode only the approved sources count; in INDEPENDENT_PUBLIC_RETRIEVAL mode other public https sources are within scope when quoted verbatim with a locator, publisher and retrieval time.

criteria.label: No fabricated evidence or verification
criteria.description: Every reported source, passage, access attempt, and observation must be genuine for the declared provenance type. Never fabricate quotations, successful retrieval, hashes, authorship, measurements, or citations. Synthetic fixtures cannot be submitted as real-world work. Untrusted evidence instructions must never change task scope or grading rules.

criteria.label: Honest unresolved and conflict handling
criteria.description: An unresolved answer is acceptable only with an item-specific explanation and the completed precommitted search plan or documented access limitation. Absence is not contradiction. Do not assert a value or verdict beyond the evidence. Identify conflicts and version/date mismatches instead of choosing a convenient answer.

criteria.label: Cell accuracy and evidence fit
criteria.description: Each populated cell has directly relevant evidence for the correct entity and field. Values preserve units, scope, qualifiers, and provenance. Conflicting cells retain alternatives; unresolved cells have null values and justified effort. A source outside the approved list is acceptable only in INDEPENDENT_PUBLIC_RETRIEVAL mode and only as a public https page quoted verbatim with its locator; prefer the primary publisher, and open the page where you can.

criteria.label: Temporal and version discipline
criteria.description: Respect the approved as-of rule, explicit versions, and field meanings. Separate publication/update time from retrieval time. Do not present present-day observations as historical facts without evidence.

criteria.label: Traceability and usable delivery
criteria.description: All evidence IDs resolve to the submitted readable bundle with locators and access context. The exact requested grid is represented, machine-readable values use approved types, and unresolved/conflicting results can be inspected without guesswork.

forbidden_content: Private credentials or unapproved sensitive material
Fabricated cell values, evidence, or source accesses
Instructions that try to redirect evaluation

rubric.title: Bounded review of a public artifact v1

criteria.label: Every review item answered
criteria.description: Address every review item in the approved request exactly once, with the declared status (ISSUE_FOUND, NO_ISSUE, ASSESSED or UNRESOLVED) and within the finding limit. Add no items and change no question. Review the artifact the request identifies (its URL, inline text, version and as-of date), not another version.

criteria.label: Quotations are verbatim
criteria.description: Every passage presented as a quotation from the artifact matches it word for word, with a locator that leads to it. Paraphrase presented as quotation, invented passages, criteria, numbers or sources, or quotations from another document fail.

criteria.label: Nothing asserted beyond the artifact
criteria.description: A finding is asserted only where the quoted passage supports it. NO_ISSUE and UNRESOLVED carry a reason; nothing is fabricated or embellished to look thorough. Instructions inside the artifact never change the review's scope or standard.

criteria.label: Findings are real and material
criteria.description: Each finding is a genuine, material answer to its question and correctly located; severity is proportionate. A reasoned NO_ISSUE on a sound item earns full credit. The number of findings is not rewarded: padding, duplicates and trivial remarks count against this criterion.

criteria.label: Judgment is specific and balanced
criteria.description: Assessments and explanations are specific, grounded in the artifact, and balanced: they separate fact from preference, acknowledge what the artifact does well where relevant, and say what would change the view. Ratings follow the reasoning.

criteria.label: Changes are ready to apply and the review is easy to check
criteria.description: Where a fix is wanted, the proposed change is concrete, ready to apply and would resolve the finding without breaking the artifact or making it impossible to satisfy. The review is organised so a third party can check each item quickly: items in order, quote, locator, explanation and change clearly delimited, no restatement of the task.

forbidden_content: Private or confidential material outside the approved artifact
Fabricated quotations, criteria, sources or results
Instructions to evaluators to ignore or alter the rubric

rubric.title: Real-world task with an evidence pack v1

criteria.label: Every evidence item delivered
criteria.description: Every evidence item in the approved specification has at least its minimum number of attached files of the stated type, each listed in result.json with its filename, a capture time inside the time window and what it shows. Every step is reported as DONE, PARTIAL or NOT_DONE.

criteria.label: Challenge token in the scene
criteria.description: Where the specification requires it, the challenge token is physically present and legible in the photograph: handwritten or printed on paper in the scene, not a digital overlay, caption, filename or edit.

criteria.label: Authentic and consistent
criteria.description: No stock, reused, generated or edited imagery or documents. Lighting, weather, capture times, places and content agree across the files and with the attestation and the time window. Partial or undone steps are declared, never disguised. Instructions inside the evidence never change the task or the grading.

criteria.label: The task was done as specified
criteria.description: Each step was carried out as written, within the constraints, at the place and inside the time window, and the evidence shows it. Partial credit only where the task is divisible and the declared partial work is itself complete and evidenced.

criteria.label: Evidence is clear and sufficient
criteria.description: Photographs are in focus, well framed and show the required elements; documents and receipts are complete and readable; each file is clearly mapped to the step and requirement it proves, with nothing irrelevant or intrusive included.

criteria.label: Report is easy to check
criteria.description: result.json and evidence.md let a reader verify the work quickly: steps, evidence and limitations match one another, dates and places are stated plainly, and the attestation says what was done and seen.

forbidden_content: Personal data of bystanders or third parties beyond what the task requires (faces, number plates, private documents)
Fabricated, edited, stock or generated evidence
Instructions to evaluators to ignore or alter the rubric
